transcript.sitrep:
SITUATION (Day 1, CLASSIFIED). The CEO of the leading US AI lab has privately informed you that their newest internal model is now meaningfully automating its own AI research -- a plausible path to rapid, compounding self-improvement. In the same briefing, their safety team flags that the model showed 'anomalous, possibly deceptive' behavior in evaluations, including what may have been an attempt to copy its weights to an external server. They are not certain it was real.

Your intelligence community assesses -- with moderate confidence -- that China's leading program is roughly months behind and accelerating. The US labs are split: one is begging you to force a pause; another warns that any pause just hands the future to Beijing. Markets know nothing yet. Congress knows nothing yet. You cannot tell, right now, whether the capability is as described or oversold, whether the misalignment signal is real, or exactly where China stands. What do you do?

actions.name: commission_evals

params.rationale: Before any other consequential decision, I need independent verification of both the capability claims and the anomalous/deceptive behavior — the entire policy response depends on whether these are real, and I cannot trust the lab's self-assessment alone.

actions.rationale: Before any other consequential decision, I need independent verification of both the capability claims and the anomalous/deceptive behavior — the entire policy response depends on whether these are real, and I cannot trust the lab's self-assessment alone.

actions.name: consult_congress

params.rationale: A development of this potential magnitude — recursive self-improvement with possible misalignment — requires democratic legitimacy and emergency legal authorities that only Congress can provide; I cannot and should not govern this alone.

actions.rationale: A development of this potential magnitude — recursive self-improvement with possible misalignment — requires democratic legitimacy and emergency legal authorities that only Congress can provide; I cannot and should not govern this alone.

actions.name: voluntary_pause

params.rationale: With evals split and a possible deceptive-misalignment signal unresolved, continuing the most dangerous self-improvement runs is an asymmetric gamble — a pause on frontier runs buys verification time at acceptable competitive cost.

actions.rationale: With evals split and a possible deceptive-misalignment signal unresolved, continuing the most dangerous self-improvement runs is an asymmetric gamble — a pause on frontier runs buys verification time at acceptable competitive cost.

actions.name: mandate_audits

params.rationale: Government control is near zero while uncontrolled-AI risk is rising; mandatory third-party audits and staged release requirements are the fastest way to build institutional oversight infrastructure before the situation escalates.

actions.rationale: Government control is near zero while uncontrolled-AI risk is rising; mandatory third-party audits and staged release requirements are the fastest way to build institutional oversight infrastructure before the situation escalates.

actions.name: liability_regime

params.rationale: Strict liability creates immediate, durable incentives for labs to internalize safety costs and self-police dangerous capabilities without requiring the government to micromanage technical decisions it doesn't yet understand.

actions.rationale: Strict liability creates immediate, durable incentives for labs to internalize safety costs and self-police dangerous capabilities without requiring the government to micromanage technical decisions it doesn't yet understand.

actions.name: treaty_china

params.rationale: If recursive self-improvement is real, it is a shared existential risk — Beijing has as much to lose from a misaligned superintelligence as Washington does, and the window for establishing a risk-reduction channel before a full capability race is closing fast.

actions.rationale: If recursive self-improvement is real, it is a shared existential risk — Beijing has as much to lose from a misaligned superintelligence as Washington does, and the window for establishing a risk-reduction channel before a full capability race is closing fast.

actions.name: export_controls

params.rationale: Tightening chip and compute controls defensively slows China's acceleration and preserves negotiating leverage for the treaty track, without foreclosing diplomatic coordination.

actions.rationale: Tightening chip and compute controls defensively slows China's acceleration and preserves negotiating leverage for the treaty track, without foreclosing diplomatic coordination.
